text: DSH Client UI VibeController 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的 DualSense 手柄悬浮控制插件。它将控制器状态显示在 shell.overlay，并把按键和摇杆输入映射到会话操作。用户可自定义按键触发指令、用语音输入转成会话文本，并通过按键操作截图、会话和工作区；浮层位置、大小与透明度可调整。适合希望用游戏手柄操作 DSH Web 的用户。需要兼容的浏览器 Gamepad；语音识别及屏幕捕获按使用功能需要浏览器支持和授权。

DSH Client UI VibeController adds a DualSense overlay to the DSH web client. Buttons map to session actions, including custom commands and voice input. Adjust the overlay size, opacity, and position; browser Gamepad support is required.
想用 DualSense 手柄操作 DSH 网页界面。
能不能把常用指令绑定到手柄按键上快速发送？
I want to control my DSH web session with a game controller.
DSH Client UI VibeController 的功能「手柄悬浮控制」：在 DSH Web 页面显示 DualSense 控制器图层，呈现按键状态，并可拖动位置、调整显示大小和透明度。连接兼容的浏览器 Gamepad 后自动显示。
DSH Client UI VibeController 的功能「按键触发会话指令」：可将手柄按键绑定到自定义文本或斜杠命令；按键后插件将命令发送给当前会话，或把文本排入会话提示队列。用户在设置中管理映射。

dsh-client-ui-vibecontroller README · dsh-client-ui-vibecontroller：Floating DualSense controller overlay for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) web surface: lights up pressed buttons and fires vibe-coding instructions straight from the gamepad.

dsh-client-ui-vibecontroller README · Features：- Live DualSense overlay in the web GUI.
- Left Stick (L3) — push to move the plugin; hold to show every button's bound function.
- Options Button - push to show settings including display size and opacity.

dsh-client-ui-vibecontroller README · Install from GitHub：Requires [pnpm](https://pnpm.io/installation) on PATH (used by the `dsh plugin` command).

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:squirrelbullet/dsh-client-ui-vibecontroller

dsh-client-ui-vibecontroller README · or, for a specific tag:：dsh plugin --profile web add github:squirrelbullet/dsh-client-ui-vibecontroller#v0.1.0
```
